scene: Spanner pocketed, you reach the busy transit plaza at the street's end.
picture: Side-view pixel scene along a cobbled plaza platform. The elderly man in his blue cap and orange cardigan stands holding his cane, a rusty spanner sticking from his pocket. On the far left sits a funicular car on slanting tracks. In the centre waits a two-wheeled rickshaw. Far right stands a tall brass elevator cage.
shown: a glass funicular car on angled rails waiting open far left
a striped bicycle rickshaw with a nodding driver waiting in centre
an ornate brass cage lift with sliding gate shut far right

variants.scene: A handy tool safe in your pocket, three ways uphill await your choice.
